mapa.visibilidade: How I appear on the map
mapa.visibilidadeTexto: Right now you appear approximately (about 5 km). The full choice — invisible, city, approximate or precise — comes with the live brothers map.
mapa.agapeTextoAviso: Real Ágapes come with the fellowship features. This is a design sample.
mapa.dadosExemplo: Brothers, clubhouses and gas stations on this map are samples until real data arrives.
mapa.ferramentasDetalhe: Weather, fuel, checklist, Agape and more
mapa.semPermissaoTexto: To see where you are, allow location for Bodes do Asfalto in your phone settings.
mapa.semGpsTexto: We could not find your position now. Go somewhere open and try again.

desc.invisivel: Nobody sees you on the map.
desc.cidade: Shows only the city you are in.
desc.aproximado: Shows an area of about 5 km. This is the default.
desc.precisoAmigos: Your friends see your exact spot.
desc.precisoComboio: Only the ride group sees your exact spot.

visib.temporarioDesc: After 2 hours, it goes back to your previous choice by itself.

explicacao.asfalto: Avoids dirt, even if the trip gets longer. If there is no other way, it tells you how many km of dirt.
explicacao.misto: The shortest way, with or without dirt.
explicacao.terra: Looks for dirt roads whenever possible.

erros.semRede: No connection to the route server. Check your internet and try again.
erros.semRota: We could not find a motorcycle route to that place with this road type.
erros.semLocalizacao: No location yet. Allow location and go somewhere open.

rota.aviso: Dirt sections come from OpenStreetMap and may be incomplete in your area.
rota.semCaminhoSoAsfalto: There is no paved-only way here. This route avoids dirt as much as possible, but has {{km}} km of dirt.

bateVolta.distancia: How far to ride (there and back)

google.verificando: Checking whether Google navigation follows this route…
google.fiel: Google calculated this route. Final confirmation happens at departure.
google.parecida: Google accepted it, but takes a slightly different way ({{km}} km). Follow along on the app map.
google.semChave: Navigation without the planned route: the Google key is missing in this build.
google.chaveSemRoutes: Google rejected the route: the key does not have the "Routes API" enabled. Navigation will use Google's route.
google.semRota: Google doesn't know part of this way (dirt: {{terra}} km). Navigation will use its own route; to follow it exactly, choose "Paved only" or follow on the app map.
google.semRede: No internet to check with Google.

pilotando.rotaRapida: Google did not accept the planned route (reason: {{motivo}}); following its route to the destination.
pilotando.sosTeste: Test version: SOS does not alert anyone yet. It will alert your group and contacts, but it does not replace 192 (ambulance) or 193 (fire brigade).
pilotando.dicaEntrada: Set the route while stopped. On the move, listen to the voice and only tap when safe.

navegacao.permissaoMotivo: We need your location to plan the route.
navegacao.aviso: Use while stopped or as a passenger. Don't touch the phone while riding.

erros.semPermissao: No location permission. Allow it in the phone settings.
erros.termosRecusados: Google's terms must be accepted to navigate.
erros.chaveNaoAutorizada: The Google key was not accepted. Tell the developer.
erros.semRede: No internet. Google navigation needs a connection.
erros.semRota: Could not plan a route to that destination.
erros.semLocalizacao: No GPS signal yet. Go somewhere open and try again.

vazios.feedTexto: Photos, trips and board notices arrive in the social stage.
vazios.passeiosTexto: Chapter schedules and the live convoy are coming soon.
vazios.conquistasTexto: Ride, visit clubhouses and join Ágapes to earn Bode Passport badges.

perfil.catalogoDesc: Every visual element in the app
perfil.emBreveCadastro: Profile editing arrives with member registration (Stage 1).
perfil.maconariaAviso: Optional. You choose who sees each field and can delete it anytime. We never ask for degree.
perfil.noMapa: How I appear on the map
perfil.ajudaDetalhe: Contact support by text or WhatsApp
perfil.ferramentasDetalhe: Weather, fuel, checklist, Agape and more
perfil.salvosDetalhe: What you kept to see later

catalogo.cartaoTexto: Leaves 7am from the clubhouse · 280 km · 18 going

movimento.texto: Feed, messages and settings are locked while the bike is moving. Stop to use them.

tema.explica: Automatic: Sun theme by day (better in strong sunlight) and Night after 6 pm.

busca.dica: Type the name of a chapter house, gas station, city, street or road.
busca.semRede: No internet: only club places are shown.

agape.como: Join a Flash Agape with brothers on the road.

irmaoNaRota.como: Meet a brother riding the same road (wave accepted and meeting confirmed).

sedesMt.como: Check in at 5 club chapter houses in Mato Grosso.

pantanal.como: Visit 3 Pantanal spots: Transpantaneira, Porto Jofre and Poconé.

visitaLojas.como: Visit 3 Lodges in other Orients during your trips.

socorroFraterno.como: Help a brother stopped on the road (aid request answered and confirmed).

conquistas.rankingTexto: {{km}} km ridden with a recorded route. The ranking resets every month.

ganhar.km: Every 10 km ridden with a recorded route
ganhar.passeio: Official club ride (check-in at start and end)
ganhar.monumento: Check-in at a monument or sight

conquistas.semVelocidade: No points for speed or travel time. Here, riding together and seeing places is what counts.

feed.exemplo: Sample posts until the social stage.
feed.emBreve: Posting, commenting and sharing arrive in the social stage.
feed.compor: Tell us about your ride, brother…
feed.compartilharTexto: Check out what happened at Bodes do Asfalto! Get the club app.
feed.denunciarExplica: Moderators will review it. You do not need to explain anything else.
feed.bloquearExplica: You will both stop seeing what the other posts. You can undo it later, in the profile.
feed.erroAcao: That did not work right now. Please try again in a moment.
feed.vazioTexto: Be the first to tell the brothers about a ride.
feed.erroCarregar: I could not load the feed. Pull down to try again.

passeios.exemplo: Sample rides until the chapters' real calendar.
passeios.criarEmBreve: Creating rides arrives with the chapter calendar (Stage 2).

avatar.ia: Coming soon: AI-made avatar from your photo (1 free per account).

ferramentas.explicacao: Everything for before you leave, for stops and for club life. Always use with the bike stopped.

tempo.explicacao: Forecast for the next hours where you are, and sunset time so you don't ride in the dark.

combustivel.explicacao: How many fuel stops, how many liters and how much you'll spend. Keeps 15% of the tank in reserve.

viagem.explicacao: Splits a long trip into daily legs, with rest breaks.

checklist.explicacao: Check everything before leaving. Saved until you reset it.

comboio.resumo: Where I am and quick notes
comboio.explicacao: Send your location and ready-made notes to the WhatsApp group with one tap.

telefones.explicacao: Call with one tap. The app SOS alerts the convoy but does not replace these numbers.

ficha.explicacao: Information for whoever helps you. It stays only on your phone.

bodeAmigo.explicacao: Brothers who offer lodging, towing, garage and repairs along the way.

agape.explicacao: Set a quick meetup where you are. It shows up right away on the map and in the feed.

irmaosPerto.explicacao: Visible brothers near you, with the position each one chose to show.

membros.explicacao: Name, nickname and chapter of the brothers. Invite a club brother to the app.

aniversarios.explicacao: This month's birthdays in your chapter.

negocios.explicacao: Brothers' businesses with discounts or special care for the club.

classificados.explicacao: Parts, gear and bikes for sale among brothers.

lojas.explicacao: Lodges registered by brothers, with meeting days and contact. Entry follows each Lodge's procedure.

eventos.explicacao: Events from the club, friendly riding clubs and Lodges.

manutencao.explicacao: Write down the km of each service. The app warns what is coming due.

meta.explicacao: Set how many km you want to ride this year and track it.

ferramentas.indicarTexto: Brother, download the Bodes do Asfalto app and request access through our chapter. TFA!
ferramentas.oiIrmao: Hello, brother! I saw your contact in the Bodes do Asfalto app.
ferramentas.exemplo: Sample data until real registration in the admin panel.
ferramentas.telefonesAviso: Official Brazilian numbers. The app never calls by itself: you confirm on the phone.

agape.aviso: The Agape uses your current position and is visible to brothers.
agape.faltaLocal: Say where the Agape will be.
agape.publicadoTexto: It already shows on the map and in the feed.

combustivel.dica: Refuel every {{km}} km at most, without relying on the reserve.

viagem.porDia: I want to ride per day
viagem.pausas: Take {{n}} 15-min breaks per day (one every 2 h riding).
viagem.dica: Avoid riding more than 8 hours a day and arrive before dark.

tempo.chuvaAviso: Up to {{pct}}% chance of rain in the next hours. Bring rain gear.

comboio.parado: Use while stopped. When moving, use the riding mode buttons.

ficha.privacidade: Stays only on this phone. Not sent to the server or other brothers.

meta.dica: Km with a recorded route count. Speed never counts.

sobre.lema: Brothers on the road, brothers for life.
sobre.historia: Bodes do Asfalto was born from Mason brothers wanting to ride together, help each other on the road and visit one another along the way. Today there are several chapters, each with its own house and board. (Sample text for the board to review.)

regras.formacao: Ride in staggered formation; the leader sets the pace and the sweep never passes.
regras.distancia: Keep 2 seconds from the bike ahead.
regras.sinais: Repeat hand signals for those behind.
regras.abastecer: Always leave with a full tank and refuel at agreed stops.
regras.alcool: Alcohol and riding don't mix: drinks only after parking for good.
regras.ninguem: No one is left behind: if one stops, the convoy waits.

sobre.revisar: Provisional text. The board can edit it in the admin panel.

publicar.texto: What do you want to share, brother?
publicar.semLocal: The location saved in the photo is removed before posting.
publicar.vazio: Write something or pick a photo.
publicar.enqueteFalta: Write the question and at least 2 options.

acesso.boasVindas: The app for Bodes do Asfalto brothers: road, convoy and fellowship.
acesso.linkExplica: Open the email on this phone and tap the link. No password needed.
acesso.soMembros: Members of Bodes do Asfalto only. After signing in, your chapter's board confirms your access.
acesso.demonstracao: See the app in demo mode
acesso.modoLocal: Test version: sign-in does not talk to the club server yet.
acesso.consentimentosExplica: Choose what you allow. You can change it anytime in Profile → My data.

termos.texto: Name, nickname, chapter and photo so brothers recognize you; your posts and trips.
termos.base: Legal basis: performance of contract (LGPD, art. 7, V).

localizacao.texto: For routes, navigation, SOS and the live map. By default brothers only see your area (~5 km). Home and work never show.
localizacao.base: Legal basis: consent (art. 7, I). You control who sees it, anytime.

dados_macons.texto: Lodge, Orient and Grand Lodge, only if you want to share. Encrypted, and each field has who can see it. We never ask for degree.
dados_macons.base: Sensitive data (art. 5, II): specific consent (art. 11, I). Revoking deletes this data.

form.explica: Your chapter has no board in the app yet. Club moderators check your details and grant access.
form.fotoColete: Photo of you wearing the club vest
form.indicadoPor: Club brother who vouches for you
form.quemAprova: The brother you name gets a confirmation request. Once your chapter has a board in the app, the board approves.
form.erroEnvio: Could not send the request. Check your internet and try again.

espera.texto: Your request for the {{capitulo}} chapter is with the board. You'll be notified when it's approved.
espera.aviso: Until approval, only this screen is available.

meusDados.explica: Review and change what you allowed, download a copy of your data or delete your account.
meusDados.revogarAviso: Revoking "masonic data" deletes Lodge, Orient and Grand Lodge. Revoking the terms ends app use.
meusDados.baixar: Download a copy of my data
meusDados.excluirTexto: Your data, posts, bikes and contacts will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
meusDados.excluida: Account deleted. See you on the next ride, brother.
meusDados.encarregado: Data officer (LGPD): the app owner. Contact via the Help button.
meusDados.erroBaixar: Could not create the copy. Try again.

acesso.revogarMacomTitulo: Delete Lodge, Orient and Grand Lodge?
acesso.revogarMacomTexto: Revoking this permission deletes that data from your profile.
acesso.termosTravados: To stop accepting the terms, use "Delete my account" below.
acesso.retornoFalhou: Could not sign in with this link
acesso.retornoFalhouExplica: The link works once and only on the phone where it was requested. Ask for a new one on the sign-in screen.
acesso.erroLink: Could not send the link. Check the e-mail and your internet and try again.
acesso.erroGoogle: Could not sign in with Google. Try again or use e-mail.

garagem.explica: Register your bikes. The main one shows on your profile.
garagem.falta: Enter at least the brand and model.

contatos.explica: Up to 3 people who receive your SOS with your location.
contatos.privado: Only you see these contacts. Neither the board nor moderators can.
contatos.falta: Enter the name and a phone with area code.
contatos.limite: You already have {{n}} contacts, the maximum.
contatos.sosAviso: The SOS alerts the convoy and these contacts. It does not replace 192/193.

perfilEditar.usarAvatar: Use the avatar instead of the photo
perfilEditar.precisaConsentimento: To add Lodge, Orient and Grand Lodge, first allow masonic data in My data. It is optional.

salvos.vazio: You haven't saved any posts yet. Tap a post's bookmark to keep it.

story.explica: A road photo with a short caption. It disappears by itself after 24 hours.
story.pedirCamera: To record a story, allow the camera. It is only used while this screen is open.
story.semMicrofone: To record video, allow the microphone in your phone settings.
story.gravando: Recording… release to stop (up to 60 s)
story.dicaCamera: Tap for photo · hold for video
story.dicaMaosLivres: Tap to start and tap again to stop
story.desenheExplica: Draw with your finger on the image. Pick color and thickness.

classificados.aviso: Buying and selling among brothers. The app does not charge or handle payments.
classificados.mensagem: Hello, brother! I saw your ad "{{titulo}}" on Bodes do Asfalto.
classificados.seguranca: Tip: meet in a public place or at the chapter house.

form.explica: Good photos sell more: daylight, clean bike, several angles.
form.semPagamento: Payment is arranged between you, outside the app.
form.whatsappVisivel: This number is shown to brothers who open the ad.

classificados.semContato: This ad has no WhatsApp. Find the brother through the chapter.

sos.posicaoPronta: Location ready. Choose who to alert: each button opens WhatsApp with the message ready.
sos.semContatos: You have not added emergency contacts yet.
sos.rodape: Sent from the Bodes do Asfalto app. Call 192/193 if serious.
sos.limite: In this test version, the automatic push alert to the convoy does not exist yet (needs the server). WhatsApp asks for one tap to send.
sos.botaoAjudaDica: Opens the emergency screen: call 192/193, alert your contacts and the brothers.

negocios.explica: Brothers' businesses, always with a benefit for club members.
negocios.souMembro: I am a member (show at the counter)
negocios.mensagem: Hello! I saw {{nome}} in the Bodes do Asfalto Guide.
negocios.privacidade: The business only gets totals (times seen, routes). Never who it was.
negocios.rodape: Want to list your business? Talk to the app owner. Payment happens outside the app.
negocios.relogioExplica: The running clock shows it is not a screenshot.

ficha.precoIrmao: Gasoline R$ {{preco}} · reported by a brother on {{dia}}
ficha.anpSemDados: ANP quality score: no data for this station yet.
ficha.lojaVisita: Visits follow the Lodge's procedure. The app only brings brothers together.
ficha.beneficioIrmaos: A brother's business, with a benefit for club members.
ficha.precoPergunta: How much is regular gasoline? (R$ per liter)
ficha.precoInvalido: Check the value: use something like 6.29.
ficha.limiteAcenos: You used today's waves. They reset tomorrow.
ficha.acenoExplica: If he accepts, the chat opens. While riding, you only get a voice notice.

emBreve.perfil: Full brother profiles arrive with the club server.
emBreve.falarContato: Contact with the Lodge brother arrives with the club server, always starting with a wave.

ficha.rotaBikerCarimbo: Rota Biker passport stamp point. Check opening hours before going.

atalhos.perguntaTexto: Want an SOS button right on your phone home screen? One tap opens the request for help to the brothers.
atalhos.iphoneTexto: On iPhone: press and hold the app icon and tap "Ask for help (SOS)".
atalhos.explica: Put SOS on your home screen. It also works by pressing and holding the app icon.
atalhos.naoSuportado: This phone does not allow pinned shortcuts. Press and hold the app icon to see SOS.
atalhos.widgetManual: Press and hold an empty spot on the home screen, tap "Widgets" and look for "SOS Bodes".
atalhos.bloqueio: Lock screen: Android does not let apps add shortcuts there. On iPhone it comes with the iPhone version.

chat.novaExplica: A chat starts with a wave. When he accepts, the chat opens.
chat.modoLocal: Test version: messages stay on this phone until the club server is on.
chat.aguardandoAceno: Waiting for him to accept the wave
chat.bloquearExplica: He will no longer be able to talk to you or wave. You can unblock later.
chat.denunciada: Report sent to moderators. It disappears from your screen.
chat.acenoEnviado: Wave sent to {{nome}}. When he accepts, you chat here.
chat.avisosExplica: Only the board posts here. Tap a message to give TFA.
chat.soDiretoria: Only the board writes in notices.
chat.vazio: No conversations yet. Tap + to wave at a brother.
chat.falhaCarga: Could not refresh the conversations. Try again in a moment.
chat.jaAcenou: You already waved at {{nome}}. Wait for the reply.
chat.acenoFalhou: Could not send the wave right now. Try again.

desafios.explica: Challenges from brothers, boards and between chapters. Complete them and earn badges and XP.
desafios.criarExplica: Your challenge goes to the chapter board or a moderator for approval.
desafios.mediaExplica: Average per active brother counts, not the total: small chapters can win too.
desafios.progresso: {{atual}} of {{meta}} km (measured by the app GPS)
desafios.aguardandoExplica: The chapter board or a moderator approves it before it shows to everyone.
desafios.tabelaExplica: Non-km challenges count as equivalent km (1 chapter house, Lodge, ride or landmark = 100 km; Ágape = 50 km). Board and inter-chapter challenges are worth 50% more.
desafios.regras: Rules: no speed or travel time; km only from the app GPS; 90-day maximum; 1 challenge created per brother per month; up to 3 active brother challenges per chapter.

erros.titulo: Give the challenge a name (at least 4 letters).
erros.umPorMes: You already created a challenge this month. Try next month.
erros.limiteCapitulo: The chapter already has 3 active brother challenges. Wait for one to end.

aprovacoes.explica: Check the vest and membership card photos. If in doubt, call the brother before deciding.
aprovacoes.vazio: No requests waiting. We will let you know when a new one arrives.
aprovacoes.motivoFalta: Write the reason for declining. It is sent to the brother.
aprovacoes.erroCarregar: Could not load requests. Check your internet.
aprovacoes.erroDecidir: Could not record the decision. Try again.

papeis.explica: Only you, as administrator, choose who is moderator, chapter board or general board. Tap a brother to change.
papeis.explicaPapeis: Chapter board: approves brothers of their own chapter and creates its rides. General board: the same for all chapters. Moderator: moderates content and approves chapters without a board in the app.
papeis.erroCarregar: Could not load the list. Check your internet.
papeis.erroMudar: Could not change the role. Try again.

notificacoes.explica: Choose what you want to receive on your phone.

detalhes.mensagem: Alert when a new message arrives.
detalhes.aceno: When a brother waves at you.
detalhes.aprovacao: Join requests and the answer to your request.
detalhes.confraternizacao: Agapes, Lodge Visits and Brother on the Road.

notificacoes.privacidade: The alert never shows the message text, only that something new arrived.
notificacoes.erroCarregar: I could not load your preferences.
notificacoes.erroSalvar: I could not save. Try again.
notificacoes.permissaoTexto: We notify you when a message, a wave or an answer to your request arrives. The alert never shows the message content. You can change this later in Profile.
